shots.focal_element: A centred 'Design' pill button that, once clicked, expands into an oversized prompt input card
shots.transition_other: Video start; no incoming transition (anchors give none)
on_screen_text: Describe what you want to create.
Let's design an interactive, dark theme
shots.typography: Large sentence-case geometric/humanist sans at medium weight for the 'Design' label with a palette icon; prompt text in the same sans at regular weight, normal tracking, placeholder in a muted grey; small sentence-case button labels. Font guess (low confidence): Anthropic's house sans (Styrene-like).
shots.what_happens: On a flat light background a cursor hovers the 'Design' label, which gains a rounded pill hover state; on click the pill morphs into a wide white card (a transient letter fragment is visible mid-morph), which resolves into a prompt input with placeholder 'Describe what you want to create.', icon buttons, Import and a disabled Send. The placeholder shimmers, then text types on character by character and the Send button becomes fully saturated once text exists.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a centred pill button with a hover fill, animate a cursor click, then morph the pill (width/height/border-radius tween) into a rounded prompt card with a soft drop shadow and type the prompt string in with a blinking caret while the Send button opacity goes from 0.5 to 1.

shots.focal_element: The prompt card with the prompt still typing, now on a dark background
on_screen_text: Let's design an interactive, dark themed graphic showing how culture flows between cities. A rotating glo
shots.typography: Regular-weight sentence-case sans for the prompt body, large and tight-leading, normal tracking, with a thin text caret; button labels small sans. Font guess (low confidence): Styrene-like sans.
shots.what_happens: The background crossfades from light to near-black while the same prompt card stays centred and the prompt keeps typing ('dark themed graphic showing how culture flows between cities. A rotating glo...'); the card grows in height as lines wrap and a faint globe begins to emerge in the dark background behind it.
shots.build_rebuild: Keep the prompt card fixed at centre, crossfade the page background from light to dark over about 0.5 s, continue the typewriter animation and auto-grow the card height per wrapped line, and fade a dim globe layer in behind it.

shots.focal_element: Prompt card gaining two file-attachment chips, then the cursor clicking Send
on_screen_text: Let's design an interactive, dark themed graphic showing how culture flows between cities. A rotating globe with the cities connected by glowing paths.
shots.typography: Same regular sentence-case sans for the prompt; attachment chips use smaller sans with file-type icons in pill tags. Font guess (low confidence): Styrene-like sans.
shots.what_happens: Over a dark wireframe-outline globe, the prompt finishes typing; two attachment chips (flows.docx, cities.xlsx) pop in above the text, the card slightly reframes, a cursor enters from bottom-right and clicks Send (pointer becomes a hand), and the card then begins to shrink/fade away.
shots.build_rebuild: Place the prompt card over a slowly rotating dark globe, append two pill chips with a quick scale-and-fade pop above the text, animate a cursor to the Send button with a hand-cursor press, then scale the card down and fade it out.

shots.focal_element: A small white status pill with a spark icon cycling 'Designing...', 'Tweaking...', 'Editing...' over a globe that progressively fills with glowing arcs
shots.transition_other: The prompt card shrinks and morphs into a compact status pill in place
shots.typography: Status words in an italic serif at regular weight, sentence case, with a light shimmer gradient sweeping across the letters; city labels on the globe in tiny regular sans. Font guess (low confidence): Tiempos-like serif italic.
shots.what_happens: The card collapses into a status pill whose label types/cycles through 'Designing...', 'Tweaking...', 'Editing...' while a shimmer sweeps the text; behind it the globe rotates, city labels appear, and glowing connection arcs accumulate. The label then clears to just the spark icon, and in the last frame a white side panel slides in from the left as the globe pulls back into an app canvas.
shots.build_rebuild: Over a rotating 3D globe, show a rounded white pill with a spark icon and an italic label that swaps between three status words with a left-to-right gradient shimmer mask, while arcs between city nodes draw on progressively behind it.

shots.focal_element: The full Claude Design app window: chat panel on the left, generated 'Every place has a story.' globe landing page in the canvas on the right
shots.transition_other: Pull-out from the full-frame globe into the app window, with the left chat panel sliding in
on_screen_text: Let's design a landing page that maps how culture flows between cities. Dark theme and an interactive globe with glowing arcs connecting them.
Add city nodes and connection arcs
I've built an interactive globe with 112 cities and 168 animated connection arcs across 6 continents. The page features:
City nodes with labels on the front hemisphere
"Every place has a story" headline with vertical stats
Describe what you want to create...
Discover how ideas, art, and culture flow between cities. 112 cities. 168 routes. One living map.
shots.typography: App chrome and chat in small regular sans, sentence case; completed checklist items struck through; the generated page uses a large regular-weight serif display headline in sentence case with the last word accent-tinted, large serif numerals, and tiny uppercase widely-tracked sans stat labels. Tiny city labels on the globe are not legible at this size. Font guesses (low confidence): Styrene-like sans, Tiempos/Lora-like serif.
shots.what_happens: The app window sits centred on a light background with a soft shadow: the left panel shows the user prompt, Claude's tool steps (Read/Write, Plan, write_file, a 5/5 progress checklist, Globe.jsx, GlobeArcs.jsx, Verifier) and a summary; the right canvas shows the generated dark landing page with a rotating globe covered in glowing arcs. The globe slowly rotates across the shot; the chat input appears at the bottom of the panel.
shots.build_rebuild: Lay out a two-pane app mock (fixed-width chat sidebar with step chips and struck-through checklist, toolbar row, dark canvas) inside a rounded window with a large soft shadow on a light page, and keep a WebGL/SVG globe with glowing great-circle arcs rotating slowly in the canvas.

shots.focal_element: The 'Tweaks' toolbar button, approached by the cursor as the camera pushes in
on_screen_text: Discover how ideas, art, and culture flow between cities. 112 cities. 168 routes. One living map.
shots.typography: Same app sans for toolbar labels (sentence case, regular-medium weight) shown very large in the close-up; generated-page serif headline and uppercase tracked stat labels as in s005. Left chat panel text is cropped at the frame edge and only partly readable.
shots.what_happens: The camera zooms in past the window edge so the app fills the frame (sidebar cropped on the left) while the cursor moves over the globe; it then pushes in hard onto the toolbar, where the hand cursor hovers/clicks 'Tweaks' next to 'Comment', with the glowing globe arcs filling the lower frame.
shots.build_rebuild: Animate a camera scale-and-translate on the app mock from the full window to a tight crop of the toolbar (about 4x), easing out as the cursor arrives on the 'Tweaks' button and switches to a hand pointer.
